review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Business Development Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding Swvl’s customer base. Qualifications Candidates should possess Inside Sales and Lead Generation skills to identify, qualify, and nurture new business opportunities.
